import re,html,pathlib
out=pathlib.Path('products/services/commissioned-technical-writing/extract.txt');out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
res=[]
for f in ['do-write.html','twilio-voices.html']:
  t=pathlib.Path('products/services/commissioned-technical-writing/raw/'+f).read_text(errors='replace')
  t=re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\1>',' ',t);t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t));t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t)
  res.append('=== '+f+' len '+str(len(t)))
  for k in ['AI','artificial','generat','\$','USD','pay','paid','honorari','donat','rights','license','eligib','countr','apply','Apply','pitch','form','ChatGPT','LLM','original','Pause','paused','not accepting','closed']:
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(k) if k!='\$' else r'\$',t):
      res.append(k+' | '+t[max(0,m.start()-160):m.end()+160])
      if sum(1 for r in res if r.startswith(k+' |'))>4: break
out.write_text('\n'.join(res))
print('\n'.join(res)[:9000])
